messages:
elaine: Quick idea — propose a VIP fast-path for inbound leads from partners/forms to cut handoff time to <60s and surface to AE-VIP queue first. thoughts?

raj: Love the idea. Main questions: how do we detect VIP reliably? partner param + high lead_score?

sam: Agreed on criteria. Suggest rule: source in (partner_form) OR company_size >= 500 && lead_score >= 85. Keep enrichment TTL small so we don't block routing.

zach: Also need geo-aware routing — AE-VIP-APAC vs AE-VIP-EMEA vs AE-VIP-NA. If no regional AE available, fallback to rr-fallback in same tier.

elaine: Exactly. SLA proposal: 60s for initial assignment, 5m for owner ack, escalate to manager if unacked. If enrichment >30s, assign to rr-fallback immediately.

raj: Can HubSpot handle that logic? We can do workflow: set property lead_priority=VIP then assignment webhook -> routing service. Example HS filter I used: `source = "partner_form" OR (company_size > 500 AND score >= 85)`

sam: For safety, put a short debounce window (10s) so we batch duplicate leads from same company. Also add a de-dup check before assignment.

zach: On Salesforce side, make sure AE-VIP assignment creates a task with SLA metadata. If AE doesn't accept, task auto-reassign after 5m.

elaine: Here's a quick config snippet for the routing service: 
```
# VIP fast-path pseudocode
if lead.priority == 'VIP':
  route = route_by_geo(lead.geo, pools=['AE-VIP'])
  if enrichment.delay > 30s:
    route = 'rr-fallback'
  assign(route)
  start_timer('accept', 300s)
```

raj: Nice. Can we add a metric for "time-to-first-owner" and a dashboard tile in console for VIPs only? We need to report weekly SLA breaches.

hubspot-bot: New workflow "VIP fast-path" created by raj at 2026-03-20T14:05:12Z :white_check_mark:

sam: I'll add the TTFO (time-to-first-owner) metric to the marketing dashboard and set an alert for >60s for any VIP in 30-min rolling window.

zach: Ops note — implement rr-fallback with seed AEs so we keep quality. Prefer round-robin over broadcast for handoff traceability.

elaine: Great. Action items: raj to push HS workflow, sam to add dashboard & alert, zach to add SF task escalation rules. I'll draft the SLA playbook and ping sales ops for sign-off. :thumbsup:

raj: On it, will submit PR for HS workflow and post link here when live.

sam: ETA for dashboards: EOD tomorrow.

zach: I'll update SF task rules in the next deploy window (Thu).

elaine: Thanks team — will compile playbook and send to @sales-ops for signoff tomorrow. :rocket:
